game_identity.player_fantasy: Be the last maintenance runner carrying unstable charge from a central core to failing relays fast enough to keep the network alive.
game_identity.central_interaction: Route, recharge, carry, and transfer charge between a central core and four decaying relay beacons.

playable_loop: Move -> recharge at core -> carry charge -> touch beacon to transfer -> manage beacon decay -> stabilize all four or black out -> retry
technology_stack: Plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript Canvas; local/offline browser; no dependencies
current_milestone: Prove and deepen the first relay-maintenance vertical slice without expanding scope prematurely.
occupied_lanes_advisory: Founding identity and minimal relay loop proposed by Game Director in director/found-blackline-relay
build_run_instructions: Open index.html in a modern desktop browser, or run python -m http.server 8000 and open http://localhost:8000.
recent_decisions: The founding Director proposes Blackline Relay as Game 001 identity.
Founding stack is dependency-free browser Canvas and local/offline.
The first loop centers on transporting charge between a core and independently decaying relays.
No-change is valid and preferable to duplicate churn.
candidate_next_work: Integration: verify launch path and make the founding branch easy for later specialists to run.
Gameplay: inspect movement and transfer feel through real interaction before tuning.
Systems: inspect charge/decay rules and expose only state needed by proven next steps.
World: shape spatial pressure around the proven relay verb without inventing a parallel game.
Experience: improve rule readability and feedback after visually inspecting the current output.
QA: independently reproduce win, blackout, recharge, relay transfer, and restart behavior.
